sentences.text: This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 05.04.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge-01, North West District, Rohini Courts New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 171/2016 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.08/2005-06/DC (N-W) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Rani Khera, Delhi.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-01, North West District, Rohini Courts New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The following relief has been sought by the appellant:

"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed to YOUR LORDSHIPS that the appeal may kindly be accepted and market value of acquired land measuring 11 Bigha 12 Biswas,
having 1/3RD share, of the Appellants be further enhanced by Rs. 50,000/- per bigha besides other statutory benefits as admissible under L. A. Act, 1894 and the Appellants be further granted additional amount as provided under section 23 (1A)
and Solatium as provided under section 23 (2) and interest on the said sum as per judgment of Sunder's case by modifying the judgment & decree dated 05.04.2023,
passed by the court of Sh. Vijay Kumar Dahiya, ADJ- 01 (North-West), Rohini Court,
Delhi in the case bearing LAC No. 171/ 2016 titled as "DHARA SINGH (D) THR. LRs.
& ORS.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/12/2023 at 00:57:58 Versus U.O.I. & ANR".
Cost of the appeal be also awarded in favour of the humble Appellant.

Any other order which YOUR LORDSHIPS deem fit and proper be also passed in favour of the Appellant."
3.

Learned counsel for appellant further states that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in LA.APP. No. 99/2023 titled Ram Kishan v. Union of India & Anr., which was admitted on 10.04.2023 and is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters' for adjudication.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This is an appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 05.04.2023 passed by the Additional District Judge-01, North West District, Rohini Courts New Delhi ('Reference Court') in LAC No. 171/2016 seeking further enhancement of the compensation amount in respect of award No.08/2005-06/DC (N-W) pertaining to the land acquired of Village Rani Khera, Delhi.
2. The following relief has been sought by the appellant:
opennyai_summary.decision:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed to YOUR LORDSHIPS that the appeal may kindly be accepted and market value of acquired land measuring 11 Bigha 12 Biswas,
having 1/3RD share, of the Appellants be further enhanced by Rs. 50,000/- per bigha besides other statutory benefits as admissible under L. A. Act, 1894 and the Appellants be further granted additional amount as provided under section 23 (1A)
and Solatium as provided under section 23 (2) and interest on the said sum as per judgment of Sunder's case by modifying the judgment & decree dated 05.04.2023,
passed by the court of Sh. Vijay Kumar Dahiya, ADJ- 01 (North-West), Rohini Court,
Delhi in the case bearing LAC No. 171/ 2016 titled as "DHARA SINGH (D) THR. LRs.
& ORS.

Cost of the appeal be also awarded in favour of the humble Appellant.
Any other order which YOUR LORDSHIPS deem fit and proper be also passed in favour of the Appellant."
3.
